gate: policy.mvl_longitudinal_enabled(CP): Honda + openpilot longitudinal + startup-latched HondaFlags.MVL_LONGITUDINAL (131072)

econ.accel: fixed pre-mode C3 Eco ceiling and fixed pre-mode cruise ceiling; positive cruise acceleration only
econ.other_behavior: donor lead trajectories, obstacles, stopping, PID, FCW, acceleration boost

exceptions: Econ only, as enumerated above. No Params/LongTune or live personality setting inputs to dynamics in MVL mode.

Manual Experimental Mode is an explicit exception to the donor's unconditional model candidate. Off excludes model acceleration/shouldStop and model-override boost; radar MPC, cruise, FCW and forced deceleration remain. On uses the donor candidate/boost. Turning Off clears only model boost state, retaining planner/PID continuity.
Host schema: allowThrottle=True, matching donor's absence of throttle suppression.
Donor accelBoost publication omitted: host schema currently has no corresponding field; computation unchanged.
Host MPC stores raw donor lead trajectories for existing diagnostics; no lead filtering/shaping.

User-selected SCC Vision/Map, speed-limit resolver/assist and custom cruise increments remain independent of MVL tuning. These may change the requested speed, not the controller gains, maps, learning, acceleration/jerk profiles or donor boost. AccelBoostSP remains unconstructed. With optional target features inactive, the target adapter is identity.
retired: Host cruise overspeed allowance runtime, helper, exports.
Host engine braking helper, SP publication, and dedicated tests. Cereal ordinal deprecation and DBC cleanup owned by parent/DBC agent.

validation.scope: Pinned git blob verification; exact AST comparison of copied algorithms and optimizer definition; differential controller/planner/solver-input/FCW/boost tests; polluted custom-settings isolation; legacy non-Honda equivalence.
validation.native_release_gate: Run test_mvl_host_native against the native acados solver, capnp imports, startup policy, settings and controller parity on the C4, then repeat acceptance checks after building the exact installed revision.
validation.not_validated: Physical actuator response, on-road behavior, future learned-state convergence, or the donor author's private settings. Source parity and native software tests are not road validation.

configuration_contract.effective_selections: Driver cruise set speed, custom button increments, SCC Vision/Map, speed-limit preferences, four personality selector and manual Experimental Mode remain effective. Honda MVL-controller ownership is startup-latched; Experimental Mode is live.
configuration_contract.first_three: Pinned donor code and checked-in defaults, not a claim about the donor author's private runtime preferences.
configuration_contract.SmartCruiseControlVision: Driver preference; not overridden by MVL.
configuration_contract.SmartCruiseControlMap: Driver preference; not overridden by MVL.
configuration_contract.SpeedLimitMode: Driver preference, including Assist; not overridden by MVL.
configuration_contract.optional_speed_controls: Normal SP target arbitration and publication, using NRDR speed-limit confirmation semantics on supported cars. Inactive target features leave MVL output unchanged; enabled features request a lower target without changing the controller tune. Opening the settings UI never overwrites the saved speed-limit choice.
configuration_contract.ExperimentalMode: Live manual selection via settings or distance-button hold. Off: cruise/radar candidates only, no model stop request or model boost update. On: donor model candidate and boost. DynamicExperimentalControl remains disabled; saved preference is never forced by this mode.
configuration_contract.AccelBoostSP: Ignored, not constructed. Donor gas-override AccelBoost participates only with Experimental Mode On; max 0.2, rate 0.025, per override 0.05, min speed 10 mph. Switching Off clears accumulated model boost.
configuration_contract.GreenLightAlert_and_LeadDepartAlert: Existing SP alert preferences remain read-only advisory events, not acceleration/trajectory inputs.
configuration_contract.not_changed: Model selection, lateral control, stock safety, hardware/gear safety guard.
configuration_contract.V_CRUISE_MAX: 145 km/h pinned locally in MVL planner; host cruise selector's 169 km/h is unchanged outside mode. Above 145 km/h, target arbitration still uses the donor ceiling.

offline_references.layout: <reference root>/<full commit>/<repository-relative path>; preserve exact git blob bytes
offline_references.verification: Normalize CRLF to LF, verify every reference against reference_blobs before execution. Explicit MVL_PARITY_REFERENCE_ROOT is authoritative and hash-checked; otherwise bundled fixtures are preferred over Git. No skips for missing references.

solver_contract: No formulation regeneration required by this mode: pinned donor and existing generated formulation share N=12, X=3, U=1, P=6, cost=6/terminal=5, constraints=4, same horizon/dynamics/constraints/cost equations/default parameters and solver options. Runtime costs/headway are parameters. SCons can rebuild on source mtime; offline staging may reuse unchanged native solver libraries. Native tests required to validate loaded artifacts.

cruise_contract.minimums: Pinned donor SP: pcmCruiseSpeed=True -> 8 kph; False -> 30 kph metric or 20 kph imperial (both values are kph).
cruise_contract.initial_caller: Donor card.py passes InitialCruiseSpeedKph (checked-in default 40). Host card.py passes experimental_mode: bool; preserve its signature, ignore that argument in MVL.
cruise_contract.resume: Exact donor last-speed/initialized guard. PCM initialization remains hardware-owned; no new resume or engagement guard bypass.
cruise_contract.pcm_ownership: PCM-controlled targets and 0/-1 sentinels are mirrored exactly as donor, without rewriting hardware-owned cruise. Initialization returns immediately for CP.pcmCruise. Software button targets use 145 kph. No CAN/gear/safety changes.
cruise_contract.settings: Custom short/long increments and SLA sidecar targets use saved preferences. With custom increments off, retain one unit short/five units long, standard 1.6 kph imperial increment and donor rounding. No NrdrCruise construction or Honda imperial remap; existing MVL minimum/maximum/initialization and hardware authority remain unchanged.
cruise_contract.wheel_hold: Distance-button hold toggles manual Experimental Mode once per hold and announces the chosen On/Off state. Releasing that hold must not also cycle personality. Short presses retain the four-personality selector. Saved HondaLiveLearningGas changes cannot change the active controller gate.
cruise_contract.parent_contract: NrdrSelfdrive preserves SLA confirmation-button reservations/consumed presses through release, so confirming a limit cannot also cycle personality or toggle Experimental. Existing cruise-availability protection remains.
cruise_contract.legacy: Non-MVL cruise helper behavior, global 0/169 limits, and boolean initialization API retained.
cruise_contract.initialization: Exact donor-default non-PCM SET: round(clamp(max(current speed kph, 40), 40, 145)). Initial SET at standstill is 40 km/h (~25 mph), intentionally restored per explicit user direction. No custom 0-mph target. Host bool argument and saved InitialCruiseSpeedKph do not affect MVL.
